observations: Hugging Face commit history lists verified uploads of ScienceWorld train/test episodes.jsonl, steps.jsonl, add_groups/add_groups_mixed.jsonl and trace_index.jsonl on May 2.

It lists eval_splits/sciworld_split_5per_K10_evalAll.jsonl on May 5 at short revision be90dd5, an eval_splits README on May 5 at 20a14eb, an 11-bank ScienceWorld one-per-type subset spec on May 5 at 74159a5, and sciworld_split_v2_9type_10per_K10_eval10.jsonl on May 6 at 81342ce.
The page marks these commits verified.
Current card describes Auto-Dreamer traces as rollout trajectories plus memory-writer outputs.
ScienceWorld corpus cardinalities are 3,592 train episodes and 1,819 test episodes.

episodes.jsonl contains one record per trajectory; steps.jsonl contains per-step observation/action/reward; add_groups files contain writer outputs; trace_index.jsonl contains task description and action sequence.
ScienceWorld fields expose 30 native task names, an 11-way functional grouping, and a 6-domain task_type in episodes.

Appendix/Table 5 describes online ScienceWorld evaluation as a Hugging Face test split subset of 7 task types, size 660, max-agent-steps 100, with task shuffling and a frozen episodes.jsonl supplied via --episodes-path.
Appendix C.3 reports original ScienceWorld dataset-release statistics of 3,604 train and 1,802 test examples across 30 task types.

The logging section says each task records success, final environment score, episode length, retrieved entry IDs/token count, writer/dreamer events and bank size, streamed to per_task.jsonl, trajectories.jsonl and dreamer_calls.jsonl; summary.json stores aggregate metrics.
The fixed-bank controlled study states methods receive an identical pre-built bank B0, consolidation is invoked once to form B*, and the frozen task agent is evaluated on a held-out set.
The author profile surfaces public artifacts named auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public and dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60, in addition to the auto-dreamer dataset.
Current search/index access did not expose immutable model-tree/file metadata for those two model repositories in this invocation.

findings.summary: The public Auto-Dreamer Hugging Face trace repository has verified artifact history before arXiv v1: core ScienceWorld trajectory/writer files are listed on May 2 and selection-spec commits on May 5-6, while arXiv v1 is May 20, 2026. This strengthens public chronology for the trace corpus but is not an execution-time or paper-evaluated-run certificate.

Three distinct ScienceWorld populations must remain separate: paper original-release statistics (3,604 train/1,802 test), public trace-corpus cardinalities (3,592/1,819), and the paper online evaluation stream (7 task types/660 frozen episodes). No checked public derivation manifest binds these populations row-for-row, so corpus presence cannot be promoted to paper-run coverage.

The public artifact history exposes explicit alternate ScienceWorld selection schemes (an 11-bank one-per-type spec and a 9-type/10-per spec). These names improve selection provenance but do not by themselves identify the paper's 7-type/660 frozen online-evaluation episodes.jsonl.

The paper specifies a static replay target bundle—episodes.jsonl, per_task.jsonl, trajectories.jsonl, dreamer_calls.jsonl and summary.json—but current public web-index searches for the run-output filenames did not surface a uyffg/Auto-Dreamer run-export bundle. This is search-surface non-return only, not a nonexistence proof.

Author Hugging Face activity confirms public checkpoint-bridge and ScienceWorld dreamer model repositories exist, but immutable tree/file/version metadata remained unresolved through the current safe-open/search surface. Checkpoint-to-paper-run binding therefore remains open rather than negatively resolved.

scope_guard: Hugging Face commit timestamps are repository chronology, not server-attested experiment execution timestamps.
Verified commit labels authenticate the repository commit surface only; they do not establish that a file belongs to the paper's evaluated 660-task run.
Filename semantics such as 9type, 11 banks or seed42 are not substituted for raw row-level content or a derivation manifest.
Search-engine non-return for run exports or model-tree metadata is not generalized into absence from all mirrors, archives, deleted revisions or unindexed Hugging Face content.

full_autodreamer_static_replay.reason: Exact 7-type/660 frozen episode manifest, row-level run exports, paper-time source/config, checkpoint identity, rewrite transaction and verifier/environment bindings are not yet jointly public and immutable on the checked surface.

exact_next_action: Do not repeat the Hugging Face top-level commit chronology unless the dataset history changes. Next, target row-level access for eval_splits/fixed_val_sets and immutable file/version metadata for uyffg/auto-dreamer-ckpt-bridge-public and uyffg/dreamer_sciworld_v2_step60 through a public metadata route that exposes exact revisions. Specifically seek the paper's seven-type/660 frozen episodes.jsonl derivation and run-export files per_task.jsonl, trajectories.jsonl, dreamer_calls.jsonl and summary.json. If row-level split content becomes readable, compute cardinality/task-type overlap against the 1,819 public test corpus and test whether an explicit deterministic derivation reaches the paper's 660 stream. If the run bundle appears, bind source/config/checkpoint/task-agent/writer/dreamer/embedder/run_id/LanceDB/environment/verifier identities and statically recompute SR, mean score, retrieval IDs and rewrite events.
